ModMetaData.name: BattIePatch: Enhanced Age Reversal
ModMetaData.author: BattIeBear
ModMetaData.description:
V1.7
This is a very straightforward mod that allows you to customize the Age Reversal cycle in RimWorld, allowing you to change how many years (1-10) the Age Reversal will remove.
Made based on a comment on my Enhanced Bioregeneration mod!
Found an issue? Like my mod? Leave a comment!
